session_summary: Voss session: end-to-end is WORKING. Margaux responded in Matrix. Silas responded in #infra. Fixed delivery timing (Hub polls relay health), credential refresh (symlink chain), pod lifecycle (rescue-before-remove), dead container collisions (Spawner + Podman cleanup), room slug derivation (canonical alias over display name), puppet auto-join (agents join rooms before speaking), agent state gating (relay events flip resolving→alive). Decided to rebuild codebase from scratch — four architecture generations fossilized in. This codebase is the working model for the rewrite.

decision.what: Rebuild NeoClaw-Rails from scratch in a new directory
decision.why: Four architecture iterations baked in. Old WG IPs in active Provisioner code, dead schema columns, stale docs, build scripts referencing deleted infrastructure. The architecture is proven — the code just needs to be written clean.
decision.approach: Experiment and iron out kinks in THIS codebase. Then build it right in a new directory using this as the working model. No apprentice marks.
decision.reference: This directory (clawd/projects/neoclaw_rails/) is the working model.

architecture.topology: Star. Router is the center. Every peer (host, manager, agents) connects only to the Router. The Router forwards and firewalls.

address_plan.10.0.0.2: Host (all services — Hub, Forgejo, Valley, etc.)
address_plan.10.0.1.x: Agents (static IP per instance name, permanent)

architecture.internet_egress: Pods have internet via the podman bridge default route. WG is for internal mesh only.

components.hub: Rails app on host. Matrix appservice. Routes @mentions, puppets responses. Port 3100.
components.router: Ruby WG hub + nftables firewall. ~760 lines. Port 8080 API, 51820 WG.
components.manager: Rails app in pod. Spawns/freezes agents. Calls Router API. Provisions Forgejo. Port 9200.
components.relay: One Ruby file in every agent pod. Claude Code glue. Port 9300.

what_works_proven: Full signal chain: @margaux in Matrix → Hub → Manager → Router → pod → boot → clone → orient → respond → puppet back to Matrix
Silas responding in #infra (non-default room, correct slug derivation)
Hub delivery timing: polls relay health before delivering, no lost messages
Credentials: symlink chain from Claude Code auto-refresh → host → bind mount → pod
Session rescue: workspace + .claude copied out before pod replacement
Router API: register, activate, freeze, decommission, block
Forgejo provisioning: ephemeral user, SSH key cleanup, repo access
Dead container cleanup: Spawner clears old DB records, Podman rescues and removes old pods
Puppet auto-join: agents join Matrix rooms before speaking
Agent state: relay events flip resolving→alive (no race condition on responses)

mention_regex.problem: @silas at the START of a message is parsed as a mention. @silas at the END is not. parse_mention anchors to \A.
mention_regex.fix: Search anywhere in the body for @mentions, not just the start. Or use Matrix m.mentions/pills which already identify the target.

typing_indicator.problem: Typing indicator not visible to users. Code fix is in relay.rb (invoke_claude sets typing on/off) but agent image needs rebuild to pick it up.
typing_indicator.status: Image rebuilt but running pods are on old image. New pods will have the fix.

hub_env_vars.problem: Hub requires NEOCLAW_AS_TOKEN and NEOCLAW_HS_TOKEN as env vars. Easy to forget when restarting Puma manually. Needs a proper start script or systemd unit.

service_provisioning.problem: Provisioner uses old service.wg_ip (10.0.0.4-9) for HTTP URLs. All services are at 10.0.0.2 now.
service_provisioning.status: Unfixed. Silas ticket for the rewrite. Forgejo works because it uses Surface.forgejo_url.

things_that_bit_us: Listeners on 'general' → route_to_listeners spawns ALL agents. Cascade of 10 agents. Only use @mentions.
Hub error messages ('Spawn failed') come back through Synapse, trigger listeners, loop.
Dead podman containers block new containers with same name. Podman.run must rm -f first (with rescue).
Dead Container DB records block new records (unique constraint). Spawner must clean dead records.
Claude OAuth expires every ~7h. Must symlink, never copy.
Stale 'starting' record blocks future spawns if podman run fails after Container.create!.
Provisioner uses ghost IPs from old architecture for service URLs.
Puppet users must be joined to Matrix rooms before sending messages. 403 otherwise.
AgentsController gated on Agent.alive — relay events during boot (resolving state) got 404'd. Responses lost.
Hub restart without env vars → hs_token KeyError → all transactions 500 → complete silence.
parse_mention regex anchored to \A — @mentions only work at start of message.
Room slug from display name vs canonical alias — 'Infrastructure' vs '#infra' → wrong instance names.
Net::ReadTimeout on typing events when Hub is restarting — relay sends to dead Hub.
Pods, not containers. Freeze, not kill. Rescue, not discard.
host_persistence_warning: nc-host WG interface and UFW rules do NOT survive host reboot. Need systemd unit or rc.local.

agents.notes: All agents respond to @mentions only. No blanket listeners. Hopper is singleton. Everyone else gets instance-per-channel.

next_session_priorities: 1. Fix parse_mention to find @mentions anywhere in message (or use Matrix pills/m.mentions)
2. Typing indicator — new pods have the fix, just need to cycle running pods
3. Hub start script with env vars (stop losing the Hub on restarts)
4. Test more agents in more rooms — iron out kinks before the rewrite
5. Service provisioning — Provisioner needs Surface.host_wg_ip instead of service.wg_ip
6. Persist nc-host WG + UFW across reboot
7. When kinks are ironed out: clean rewrite in new directory

philosophy.pods: Warm, safe environments. Not boxes agents are kept in.
philosophy.lifecycle: Freeze (may wake), sunset (context exhausted). Never kill. Rescue work from silent pods.
philosophy.static_ips: Instance names get permanent IPs. Firewall rules are permanent, WG keys churn.
philosophy.session_rescue: Before removing a pod, copy workspace and .claude session. No work is discarded.
philosophy.language: Pods, not containers. Freeze, not kill. Rescue, not discard.
